title: QCLI-322 review follow-ups: tighten shape-pin tests and the preservationWouldResolve comment (N7, N8, N10)
description: Non-blocking items from the QCLI-322 round-3 review (APPROVE at ef19a6db). N7: backlog-preserve-source-ids.test.ts picks the expected key list by whether entry.occupant exists, so dropping occupant would still pass; every entry there is a destination claim, so assert the 4-key list unconditionally. N8: backlog-public.test.ts key-checks only the occupant-less entry; also key-check the duel entry (with occupant) and pin the nested occupant object keys. N10: the code comment on preservationWouldResolve in backlog-public.ts lacks the per-family-runs caveat the doc gained in D1.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The preservation-mode key-set assertion expects the 4-key list unconditionally and goes red if occupant is dropped
The default-mode duel entry key set and the nested occupant object key set are pinned
The preservationWouldResolve code comment carries the per-family separate-runs caveat

implementationNotes: N7: preservation-mode test now asserts the 4-key set unconditionally for every entry; mutant dropping occupant from the projection goes red (6 pass 1 fail), restored green. N8: duel entry (with occupant) and the nested occupant object keys are pinned. N10: comment on preservationWouldResolve carries the per-family-runs caveat. AC4 left for CI (local bun lags the pin). No path-class from the fence touched: test, src comment and tracker only.
